title: Cancellation on both coordinates of the comparison cone
statement: Fix prime l, finite E/Q_l, a scheme isomorphism g and any unbounded complex P. Let a be a natural map from its pullback quotient tower to inverse image of its quotient tower, normalized on unit generators. Let e be an isomorphism from inverse image of its quotient cone to the cone of its inverse-image quotient tower, with the specified first and shifted coordinate equations. The specified Roos comparison followed by H(a) and e inverse equals exact inverse image of the actual strict quotient-cone augmentation as a whole chain map. No K-flatness, flat terms, completion calculus or completedness assumption is needed for this chain calculation.

source.place: Clause (2), pullback commutes with reductions, and clause (3), second paragraph: agent-formulated identification of the specified inverse-image comparison with the completion unit. Compare Stacks derived.tex Tag 08TC (definition-derived-limit) and the explicit cone map of def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison (b).

proof.text: For each quotient index, evaluate the finite comparison followed by multiplication on every degree and site section. The defining generator formula for the specified finite comparison and the normalization of multiplication return the original section. The actual quotient unit has precisely this pure-tensor section formula. Extensionality therefore gives theta_n followed by a_n equals G of the actual quotient unit, directly in the quotient tower presentation.

Write v for the actual strict quotient-cone augmentation. Its first coordinate is the actual unit tuple and its shifted coordinate is zero. The finite identities and eta first-coordinate equation identify the first coordinates of the specified comparison followed by H(a) and G(v) followed by eta. The shifted-coordinate equations show both vanish. The mapping-cocone decomposition of the identity makes the chain maps equal. Cancel eta to obtain the asserted whole chain-map identity.

proof_origin.place: Clauses (2)–(3), explicit strict quotient augmentation and multiplication cancellation.

lean.statement:
theorem isomorphismRoosUnitCancellation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (a : (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E g).obj P ⟶
      (trfInverseImageTower l E g).obj ((trfQuotientTowerFunctor l E Y).obj P))
    (e : (trfInverseImageComplex l E g).obj
        (integralOperationsRoos ((trfQuotientTowerFunctor l E Y).obj P)) ≅
      integralOperationsRoos ((trfInverseImageTower l E g).obj
        ((trfQuotientTowerFunctor l E Y).obj P)))
    (hj : TrfMultiplicationGeneratorNormalized l E g P a)
    (heta_fst : e.hom ≫ CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
        (trfInverseQuotientDifference l E g P) =
      (trfInverseImageComplex l E g).map
        (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst (trfQuotientDifference l E Y P)) ≫
      trfQuotientProductComparison l E g P)
    (heta_snd : ∀ p : ℤ, e.hom.f (p + 1) ≫
        (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd (trfInverseQuotientDifference l E g P)).v
          (p + 1) p (add_neg_cancel_right p 1) =
      (inverseImageIntegralModules l E g).map
        ((CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd (trfQuotientDifference l E Y P)).v
          (p + 1) p (add_neg_cancel_right p 1)) ≫
      (trfQuotientProductComparison l E g P).f p) :
    inverseImageRoosComparisonComplex l E g P ≫ integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map a ≫
        e.inv =
      (trfInverseImageComplex l E g).map (trfStrictQuotientConeAugmentation l E Y P)
